name: app.tabtree/tabtree
title: TabTree
description: Build mind maps, kanban boards and whiteboards in your TabTree account, team spaces included.

environmentVariables.name: TABTREE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your TabTree connector key: create it in TabTree, Settings → Account → Claude connector (it starts with tt_live_). Claude reads and builds maps and kanban boards in your account — and in the team spaces you belong to — on every device.

environmentVariables.name: TABTREE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Legacy, TabTree Classic only (the discontinued local file): a backup folder to read and write instead of an account. Leave empty.
